Willow J

About

The person
behind the system.

Willow is a sharp, composed operator built at the intersection of business, data, culture and people.

Raised in Atlanta and shaped by both Atlanta and London, she brings a rare combination of warmth, precision and institutional discipline to R&R Entertainment.

Her instinct is simple: understand the system, find the gap, and fix it. That instinct was shaped early by the family businesses and ledgers she grew up around, then formalized through a B.S. in Computer Science from Spelman College, an Executive Leadership degree from the London School of Economics, and certifications in Six Sigma and Analytics.

At R&R, she rose through the organization rather than arriving at the top. Her defining move was a self-initiated Six Sigma audit of the company's operations, identifying process gaps and inefficiencies before taking on the General Manager role.

Today, Willow also leads Brand Partnerships, making her a central point of connection between R&R, its artists, sponsors and marketplace relationships.

Her approach

That's the
Six Sigma in me.

Willow trusts systems and data over vibes. She processes quickly, speaks economically, and leads with precision without losing sight of the people inside the system.

She doesn't perform confidence. She simply has it.
